Planscherel Measure on Eq(2)
H. Ahmedov1 and I. H. Duru2,1
1. TUBITAK, Feza G¨ursey Institute, P.O. Box 6, 81220 Cengelkoy, Istanbul,
Turkey 1.
2. Trakya University, Mathematics Department, P.O. Box 126, Edirne, Turkey.
Abstract
Following the construction of the invariant integral and the scalar product
for the quantum Euclidean group Eq(2), we obtained the full matrix elements
of its unitary irreducible representations from SUq(2) by contraction and then
derived the Planscherel measure.
July 1998
1E–mail : hagi@fge1.gursey.gov.tr and duru@fge1.gurse

blocks.title: Introduction
blocks.content: If the space--time is not a differentiable manifold but a non--commutative geometry there may be interesting new physical effects. Because of the non existence of sufficiently developed differential calculus on the non--commutative geometry to study physical effects one needs new mathematical tools. Since on the other hand the quantum group spaces are natural examples for the non--commutative geometries it is of interest to develop an algorithm that can be employed in physical applications. Matrix Elements of the Irreducible Representations of $E_q(2)$ from $SU_q(2)$ by Contraction
blocks.content:
Unitary representations of $E_q(2)$ are previously studied [@5]. We now show that the matrix elements of the unitary irreducible representations of $E_q(2)$ can be obtained from the ones of $SU_q(2)$ by contraction.
